edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: Lysosomal dysfunction affects both the central and the peripheral nervous systems, including the enteric nervous system (ENS) where accumulation of storage material and neuronal loss may directly contribute to GI dysmotility.
